name: Kistennin
text: Kistennin is an alternate spelling of the name Custennin. The name appears often in the early Welsh written record. The best-remembered bearer is the shepherd who helped Culhwch find Olwen in the tale Culhwch ac Olwen. His son is Goreu, the young man who finally slew the giant Ysbaddaden.
